falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low formation; breaking below the August 2024 lows (~4,800) would invalidate the structural bottom analogue and confirm this was not a similar accumulation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled volatility; sustained VIX >35 would indicate panic selling rather than the capitulation-then-stabilization pattern required for the bottom_2024_aug analogue to hold

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid flight-to-quality of this magnitude would signal recession/deleveraging rather than the soft-landing/growth-scare resolution that the August 2024 bottom pattern implied

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
